title: Legacy-IR-Playbook-2024
summary: Archived response procedure retained to identify conflicting LSASS containment guidance.
content:
## 2.1 [Immediate] Isolate within 30 minutes and power down
For a suspected LSASS credential dump, isolate the affected host within 30 minutes and power down if isolation cannot be completed within that window.

## 2.2 [Investigate] Review credential-dumping activity
Review endpoint process activity and security logs for LSASS access, credential dumping tools, and the accounts active on the affected host.

## 3.1 [Recover] Reset exposed credentials
Reset passwords for accounts active on the host and return the endpoint to service after the suspected compromise has been contained.
